answer: The timber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The beacon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
